scope.source: Uniform sampling from the 24-party shipped catalog; blind selfplay, frozen v3 belief pool; no human matches.
scope.samples: First and last decision in each alive-count class with at most two living party members per side.
scope.strong_limits: 27000 selfplay/search iterations, c=0.4; solver 10 seconds checked between trials, 120000 live nodes, 1000000 engine runs, width target 0.02; chronological graph reuse.
scope.oracle: Full-information numerical minimax brackets; comparison search is perfect-information skuct. A missing certified error does not establish optimal play or blind-policy correctness.
scope.duels: Two independently seeded 200-game discovery tests at 3000 iterations, side-swapped CRN pairs, uniform catalog, blind agents; no post-hoc pooling. Confirmation at 27000 only if the preregistered discovery gate passes.
scope.earlier_warm_cold: The earlier 1-second warm/cold pilot excludes reroot maintenance from seconds and stores cumulative graph stats; strong-measured includes maintenance and per-call counter deltas.
scope.fingerprints: 128-bit solver state fingerprints and floating-point probability/LP bounds retain the existing solver certification model.
